opportunities.title: Dark Sun's Original Creators Are Building a New World — Here's What the 2e Rules Actually Said About Athas
opportunities.why_now: EN World's Aug 30 podcast reveals Dark Sun's original designers are working on a new setting, reigniting interest in the classic 2e ruleset that made Athas brutal by design.
opportunities.angle: Rules-deep-dive: pull the original Dark Sun 2e mechanical innovations (defiling magic, no clerics, psionics-for-all) and ask which survive in a 'new world' built by the same hands.

opportunities.title: Arcana Unleashed Previewed: What's Actually Different From 5e's Spellcasting Rules
opportunities.why_now: The Aug 30 EN World podcast previewed Arcana Unleashed, a third-party alt-rules product, giving fans their first concrete look at its mechanics.
opportunities.angle: Comparison chart format: line up Arcana Unleashed's spell rules against 5e/2024 core rules to show exactly what's changing, not just vibes.

opportunities.title: Daggerheart Doesn't Need Improvised Monsters — Here's the Written Rule Sly Flourish Skipped
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish's Aug 31 piece on improvising Daggerheart monsters is trending among GMs looking for shortcuts.
opportunities.angle: Rules-first rebuttal/companion: cite the actual Daggerheart adversary-building rules from the core book and show how they already give you what the 'lazy' method approximates, saving prep time correctly.

opportunities.title: New D&D Video Games Announced — Which Ones Are Actually Using 2024 Rules?
opportunities.why_now: EN World's podcast teased new D&D video games, and fans are already asking whether they'll reflect the 2024 core rulebooks or legacy 5e.
opportunities.angle: Fact-check tracker: list each announced game and flag confirmed/unconfirmed rules-edition sourcing, updating as info drops.

opportunities.title: Want to Start a TTRPG Podcast? Here's the One Rule About Citing Sources Most Shows Break
opportunities.why_now: EN World's Aug 31 'Launch Your Own Podcast' guide is prompting a wave of new TTRPG podcasters this fall.
opportunities.angle: Meta/service piece in the channel's voice: a short checklist for citing official rulebooks/errata correctly on air so new podcasters don't spread misinformation.
